name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 5: Rya åsar - Karlsaflogarna
description: Rya åsar to Karlsaflogarna. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Rya åsar / Björbobacken start access cluster (parking)
waterSources: Viskan, Kypesjön and Karlsaflogarna ponds: These are scenic, fishing or bathing waters, not drinking-water sources.
notes: Naturkartan says Sjuhäradsleden as a whole is not fully quality-assured by Västkuststiftelsen, and STF warns some reroutes may not be updated. Västsverige says stages 3-7 are quality-assured.
Naturkartan API site data says publish_gpx=false, while the public Naturkartan .gpx URL returns a valid GPX.
Naturkartan GPX/KML starts at [57.746806, 12.920285], while Borås/OSM access coordinates are around [57.745184, 12.919490], about 186 m away.
Naturkartan GPX ends at [57.743806, 13.106420], Borås converted coordinate is about 54 m away at [57.743817, 13.107335], and OSM endpoint is about 160 m away near the shelter cluster.
OSM relation 4177360 is connected but stored in reverse, about 0.441 km longer than Naturkartan/KML, and diverges most near [57.7428, 13.0060].
AllTrails calls the route Björbostugan - Sandryd, Wikiloc mentions Toarps kyrkan, and E1 Hiking Europe lists the reverse Karlsaflogarna - Rya åsar.

facilities.name: Rya åsar / Björbobacken start access cluster
facilities.description: Start access cluster for Etapp 5 near Rya åsar/Björbobacken, with information board, parking, toilet and waste basket. It is about 200 m from the Naturkartan route start. Deduplicate with section 4 Rya åsar end access facilities.

facilities.name: Borås Camping & Vandrarhem
facilities.description: Paid all-year accommodation/service cluster near the route with camping pitches, hostel, cabins, restaurant/bistro, shop, toilets/showers/service buildings, grills, laundry, guest water and waste handling. Useful lodging/resupply/access service, but customer utilities should not be imported as free trail utilities. Do not model toilets/water/waste as free public trail utilities unless confirmed.

facilities.name: Björbo hage / Björbostugan grillplats
facilities.description: Grill/fireplace near Björbostugan/Björbo hage. Official text says a grill is about 0.2 km from the route; OSM has a fireplace/picnic point near the route. Check municipal object name/placement if possible before final normalization.

facilities.name: Sjöboskolans skolskog rest area
facilities.description: Official brochure says there are tables and benches at Sjöboskolans skolskog. Nearby Sjöbo district services are useful access/resupply context. Exact table geometry not fully verified.

facilities.name: Kypesjöns badplats / Kypegården
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place by Kypesjön with beach, jetty, accessible bathing ramp, summer toilets/changing hut, seasonal cafe/refreshments, grills, shelter and nearby parking. Havs- och vattenmyndigheten lists 2025 classification as excellent quality for the 2026 bathing season. Toilets/cafe are seasonal/opening-hour dependent; do not import Kypesjön lake as drinking water.

facilities.name: Kypesjön badplats vindskydd/grill
facilities.description: Shelter and grill/fireplace at Kypesjön badplats/Kypegården. Deduplicate with other Kype-area grill records.

facilities.name: Kypesjön grillstuga, south side
facilities.description: Accessible grill house on the south side of Kypesjön opposite the outdoor center/bathing place. Close enough to route for nearby cluster, but may be a separate object across/around the lake edge.

facilities.name: Ymergården
facilities.description: IK Ymer facility where Sjuhäradsleden passes. Current IK Ymer says the outdoor grillstuga is open to all; older stage brochure adds cafe winter Sundays, water refill and toilets when the clubhouse is open, with July closure. Model as service/rest access with opening-hour caveats. Food/water/toilet subclaims are seasonal/opening-hour dependent.

facilities.name: Karlsaflogarna / Toarps vindskydd
facilities.description: Shelter/rest hut by one of the small Karlsaflogarna ponds near the end of the stage. Official stage text says there is a grill and rest hut; OSM names the shelter Toarps vindskydd. Borås rules/safety lane did not explicitly confirm overnight use here; avoid labeling as overnight shelter unless separately verified.

facilities.name: Karlsaflogarna firepit
facilities.description: Firepit beside the Karlsaflogarna/Toarps shelter cluster. Usability depends on current fire-ban status.
